items.summary: Recommendation: retain containment and reject the proposed CRO portfolio and control-plane work this cycle. Financial evidence supports no new spend or monetization forecast. Amazon reports 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission for 2026-09-21, all under an unattributed aggregate row. AI usage cost is $1,002.46 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,531 calls, but the periods and attribution bases do not align; contribution margin, ROI, and cost-to-learn are therefore not calculable. The minimum next financial action is a report-only cost-and-revenue reconciliation using existing records, with no duplicate telemetry or spend. Preserve the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request as capacity-gated; its 61-click baseline is a learning metric, not revenue evidence.

Known cost exposure: September AI usage is $1,002.45979265, including 5,531 calls, 234 errors, and 5 transient errors. This equals approximately $0.1812 per call, but it is not cost-to-learn because measured learning outcomes and experiment-level cost allocation are absent. Infrastructure, domain, hosting, labor, and marketing spend are not present in the brief, so total operating cost and budget exposure are unknown. Minimum measurement for a true contribution-margin view is date-aligned site/experiment revenue, AI cost, infrastructure/domain cost, and any approved labor or marketing allocation.
